decision: Allow at most four compiler jobs for ordinary and mutation builds; keep sanitizer build at two. Scheduler-only adjustment; effective compilation flags, source, test/target coverage, exception/build-type matrix and each600-second deadline remain unchanged.
reason: Eight affinity-visible CPUs and approximately6.9GiB available memory support a bounded four-job ordinary build scheduler, reducing cold compilation time within the original run budget. No CPU quota information was available.
